findings.issue: Declining Tools/MCP confirmation was drawn as play.abort, which would falsely imply automatic deletion of the uncommitted edit.

findings.issue: Prepare failure cleanup was stated as a guaranteed deleted edit. DELETE is best effort and its error is discarded; early creation/ID errors precede the cleanup closure.
source: native/play_store.rs:288-291 let _ = DELETE on closure error
findings.resolution: p6 says Prepare failed / DELETE attempted; note explicitly says best effort, cleanup not confirmed and no commit.

findings.issue: Complete receipt alone was drawn as ready_for_next_request / native worker idle. Completed outcome and idle worker are separate conditions.
findings.resolution: gr now asks Receipt complete + Worker idle before the ready node.

findings.issue: storage.prune was described as deleting only entries older than older_than_days. Optional max_job_log_mb can additionally select younger finished jobs until the retained log budget is met.
source: native/storage.rs:93-111 age selection, then budget selects oldest retained finished jobs
findings.resolution: p2 now says eligible finished entries; note explicitly documents age OR optional log budget, including younger finished jobs. Active jobs and external artifacts stay protected.
